problem_statement: Title: merge_configs() overwrites nested dicts instead of deep-merging. Current behavior: merge_configs({'db': {'host': 'localhost', 'port': 5432}}, {'db': {'port': 5433}}) returns {'db': {'port': 5433}} — 'host' is lost. Expected behavior: Should return {'db': {'host': 'localhost', 'port': 5433}}.
hints: Consider how to handle the case where both base and override have the same key as a nested dictionary.
